title: Registration Payment Allowance on Self-Pay Payoffs (Hospital Account (Encounter Billing))
content:
**Clause.** On a self-pay Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) account paid off in full, the account's point-of-service payments (a payment made at registration) are totalled: at least 250.00 USD adds 1.5 percentage points to the self-pay payoff discount percent, above 0.00 but below 250.00 adds 0.75 percentage points, and none adds none.

| Point-of-service payments on the account | Percentage points added |
|---|---|
| 250.00 or more | 1.5 |
| above 0.00, below 250.00 | 0.75 |
| none | none |

*Cases (hypothetical).* A 300.00 deposit paid at the registration desk on arrival: 1.5 points. A 50.00 registration payment and a 500.00 portal card payment: only the 50.00 is a point-of-service payment, so 0.75 points.
